info.name: TestApp API — beta-ddd
info.description:
Executable API contract for the beta-ddd branch.

Run folders in collection order. The default run creates and archives disposable tests, creates one active direct assignment with two completed attempts, and cancels the disposable group assignment. Dead-letter mutations are opt-in.

Canonical API: /api/v1. Authentication: local Keycloak fixture users.
